name: Processing
description: A flexible software sketchbook and language for learning to code in the visual arts.
summary: Fully AI-generated pull requests are not accepted. AI may be used only assistively, like a reference or tutor, not to write code; contributors must understand, test and take responsibility for every line and note which AI tools they used.

evidence.quote: This project does not accept fully AI-generated pull requests. AI tools may be used assistively only.
If you do end up using AI tools, we ask that you only do so assistively (like a reference or tutor) and not generatively (having the tool write code for you).
Disclose usage: Note which AI tools you used in your PR description
Take responsibility: You are accountable for bugs, issues, or problems with your contribution
Generate documentation or comments without your review
